useCases: MechPro is a B2B SaaS platform for mobile mechanic and auto repair shops. We use Anthropic Claude via Amazon Bedrock to power AI diagnostics (symptom and DTC analysis), repair estimates, step-by-step repair guides, phone call transcript analysis for service writers, inventory ordering suggestions, and marketing content generation. Inputs are vehicle descriptions, repair complaints, and shop business context. No end-customer PII is sent to the models.
